decision: owner decision R31, 2026-10-28 (ADR-0126): best models first, matched to each role's needs; owner decision R34, 2026-10-28 (ADR-0129): every Go model incl. the translation candidates, the paid OpenRouter DeepSeek route for escalation and overflow only

method.served_build: a route in served_builds takes the LiveBench 2026-10-14 score of the build it serves, only in a category where 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-25 give every model they both score the same score (comparable); otherwise it is unscored there
method.noise_band: 1.96 * 50 / sqrt(nq) points (95% half-width, worst case p=0.5)
method.v1_nq: not published in the v1 table; 50 assumed (NOT-PROVEN)
method.order: best first: category score, highest first; an equal score: larger monthly allowance, then route key (owner 2026-10-28: 'model-model terbaik saat ini yang berjalan, selanjutnya model lainnya')
method.band: metadata only (source_refs[].band, for later load spreading): a band takes every model within the noise band of its best remaining score; it never re-orders against the score
method.unscored: never omitted; after the scored routes of the tier: LiveBench v1 overall where present (highest first), then larger monthly allowance, then route key (order_evidence)
method.tiers: OPENCODE_GO first (the superseded routes last, overflow only), then OPENROUTER_FREE (PUBLIC only: eligibility filters it for INTERNAL), then OPENROUTER_PAID (escalation and overflow only, never PUBLIC: paid_use)
method.never_listed: any Claude-family model and meta-routers (aeos.core.model_policy, AGENTS.md invariant 6); Gemini 4 Argon and the Qwen models are listed since owner answer R34 (serving NOT PROVEN until their probes pass)
method.effect: re-orders routes that are already eligible; never makes a route eligible
